name: Rizuhble's Pinball Wraith

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-10,400 (levels 1-17). 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Tesla Bullets, spirit 4.8k at Surge of Power. Ultimate (Telekinesis) is available from Tesla Bullets.

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Tesla Bullets completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Tesla Bullets completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Surge of Power, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Tesla Bullets completes 3,200 souls on. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Tesla Bullets completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Spirit Lifesteal later. Until then it speeds up camps: +25% weapon damage and +25% bullet resist against non-hero targets.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Card Trick: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Card Trick: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +26.6 on its damage (0.95x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 10,400-24,800 (levels 17-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Card Trick T3, Full Auto T3. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Enduring Speed.

items.name: Ricochet
items.caption: Bounced bullets carry your bullet procs, so Tesla Bullets' shock gets extra rolls on up to 2 more enemies within 13m at 65% damage when they stand together. Takes weapon from 5,600 to 12,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 46 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 3200.0 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 1600.0 souls (~1.6 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 800.0 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Shredder
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,800-53,600 (levels 28-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Project Mind T3, Telekinesis T3.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Card Trick: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Quicksilver Reload (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.caption: Charges up while you hit enemy heroes, paying out +30 spirit, +25% fire rate and +10% spirit lifesteal; Full Auto T3 removes reloads while it lasts, which keeps you shooting. Takes weapon from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 46 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Silencer
items.caption: The silence lasts 2.5s and the target is then immune for 10s, so you get one silence per target roughly every 12.5s: save the build-up for an escape or a key cast. Takes weapon from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Ricochet? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.
sections.desc: Dying after Ricochet? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Silences and hexes keep stopping your teleport.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is out-shooting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult you can see coming, like Lash's or Infernus's.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Project Mind (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep cancelling your teleport and your ult.

items.name: Capacitor
items.caption: Chain count goes from 4 to 6 and damage per chain from 33 to 43; the new part is a projectile that slows by up to 60% and silences movement abilities, on a 40s item cooldown. Same-slot upgrade of Tesla Bullets for 3,200 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 5..

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.caption: Each spirit hit adds 4.5% spirit amp, at most one stack per 0.7s, so 12 stacks (54%) take about 8.4s of continuous spirit damage on one target: it pays off in long fights, not in a card burst. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 52 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 33,600 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Indomitable
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Reactive Barrier for 4,800 more souls: cooldown reduction on proc 0 to 20; bullet resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
